description: Implementation of ClaimService with methods for submitting claims, updating claim status, and querying claims by reference or customer. It manages claim creation, status changes, and audit logging within an insurance management system.

classes.name: ClaimServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for handling claim-related operations, including submission, status updates, and retrieval with audit logging.

methods.name: submitClaim
methods.description: Creates and saves a new claim, initial status history entry, and audit log.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing claim, records the change in history, and logs the action.

methods.name: findByReference
methods.description: Retrieves a claim by its reference code, returning an Optional.

methods.name: listForCustomer
methods.description: Lists claims for a specific customer, filtering by status based on enabled status.
